answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 39482 Country: India Title: Is it necessary to do wudhu during the ghusl or the wudhu automatically gets completed while doing the fardh of ghusl? Please reply soon Question: Is it necessary to do wudhu during the ghusl or the wudhu automatically gets completed while doing the fardh of ghusl? Please reply soon. Answer ID: 39482 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 930/546/L=1433) Ghusl is major taharah and wudhu is done automatically with it. However, doing wudhu before ghusl is another sunnah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
